entries.title: A crewmate its model's safety filter refuses stops retrying after three tries
entries.body: When a Claude model's safety filter refuses a crewmate's conversation three times in a row, the app now stops sending it again, the task reads Stuck at its provider, and your first mate can continue it in a fresh conversation or on another model. Before, the app kept sending the same refused message every 15 minutes with no end, and the first mate's restart was turned down.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the existing Stuck at its provider status appears, not how any view looks.
